class.name: RailVehicleHorns
class.description: Exactly three fixed slots - the low horn, the high horn and the whistle - the original's warning signal bits 1, 2 and 4 ([code]WarningSignal[/code]; [code]Train.cpp[/code]'s [code]OnCommand_hornlowactivate[/code] and the rest, [code]DynObj.cpp[/code]'s dispatch to [code]horn1:[/code]-[code]horn3:[/code]). The original has no FIZ setting for the horns: which a vehicle has is implied by the MMD's buttons and sounds. Whether a cab's key reaches a horn is the cab's business; the vehicle sounds whatever it is told.

method.name: get_high_active
method.description: Whether the high horn sounds - pressed, or the alarm chain's emergency signal of a moving vehicle.

method.name: get_high_pressed
method.description: Whether the high horn is pressed.

method.name: get_horn
method.description: The horn pressed: 1 the low one, -1 the high one, 0 none.

method.name: get_low_active
method.description: Whether the low horn sounds - pressed, or the alarm chain's emergency signal of a moving vehicle.

method.name: get_low_pressed
method.description: Whether the low horn is pressed.

method.name: get_whistle_active
method.description: Whether the whistle sounds - pressed, or the alarm chain's emergency signal of a moving vehicle.

method.name: horn_high
method.description: The high horn pressed or let go.

method.name: horn_low
method.description: The low horn pressed or let go.

method.name: whistle
method.description: The whistle pressed or let go.
